newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average drops 200 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average drops 200 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average tumbled 200 points in late afternoon trading Thursday on worries about the jump in long-term interest rates.
Shortly after 3:35 p.m. EST, the Dow was off 202.43 points at 6,678.27.
The Treasury's 30-year bond lost 1-8/32, and its yield shot up to 7.09 percent from 6.98 percent at Wednesday's close. Bond prices and yields move in opposite directions.
